test_check_command_security: test the check_command_security function returns allow, block, or warn based on tirith exit codes
test_ensure_installed: test the ensure_installed function returns a tirith binary path or launches a background install thread
test_cosign_verification: test the _verify_cosign function validates binary signatures using cosign verify-blob and returns True, False, or None
test_install_tirith: test the _install_tirith function downloads, verifies cosign and SHA-256 checksums, extracts and installs the tirith binary
test_disk_failure_marker: test the _mark_install_failed, _is_install_failed_on_disk, and _clear_install_failed functions persist and manage install failure markers with TTL expiration
